comments.body: A photo of the ring and the gills? The ring has stripes. "The flesh of the mushroom is white, becoming pink when bruised or exposed to air. This is a key feature in differentiating it from the poisonous false blusher or panther cap (Amanita pantherina), whose flesh does not. The stipe (stem) is white with flushes of the cap colour, and grows to 5–15 cm.The gills are white and free of the stem, and display red spots when damaged. The ring is striate (i.e. has ridges) on its upper side."
